mapper.select: SELECT * FROM artist WHERE is_active = true
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO artist(user_id, name, bio, profile_image, instagram, slack_webhook_url, google_calendar_id) VALUES(#{userId}, #{name}, #{bio}, #{profileImage}, #{instagram}, #{slackWebhookUrl}, #{googleCalendarId})
mapper.update: UPDATE artist SET user_id = #{userId}, name = #{name}, bio = #{bio}, profile_image = #{profileImage}, instagram = #{instagram}, slack_webhook_url = #{slackWebhookUrl}, google_calendar_id = #{googleCalendarId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE artist SET is_active = FALSE, deactivated_at=NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE artist SET is_active = TRUE, deactivated_at= NULL WHERE id =#{id}
